_note: Decoy apps on the dock (desktop-ui addition 2026-11-02, author: 加几个常见的，让屏幕感受更真实). They have no function. Clicking one shows its `window` (a small empty system window with one line) and/or makes Kuro say a line in its HUD bubble. `kuro` picks the first entry whose day range covers today. `gone` from that day the tile stays but opens an admin notice. Claude owns this file.
